name: Kansa Wand Face & Foot Massager | Ayurvedic Bronze Massage Tool with Wooden Handle | For Face, Neck, Head & Body
description:
Enjoy a relaxing self-care massage with the Kansa Wand Face & Foot Massager. Featuring a traditional Kansa/bronze massage head and a comfortable wooden handle, this handheld massage tool is designed for use on the face, neck, head, feet, and other body areas. Its compact and lightweight design makes it convenient for home, spa, and wellness routines.

Key Features
Traditional Kansa/bronze massage head
Comfortable and easy-to-hold wooden handle
Smaller massage surface suitable for the face, neck, and head
Larger surface suitable for feet and other body areas
Manual design with no batteries or charging required
Can be used with massage oil, moisturizer, or serum
Helps provide a soothing and relaxing massage experience
Lightweight, compact, and portable
Easy to use as part of a daily self-care routine
Suitable for home, spa, and wellness use

Product Specifications
Product Type: Kansa Massage Wand
Massage Type: Manual Massage
Massage Head Material: Kansa/Bronze
Handle Material: Wood
Suitable Areas: Face, Neck, Head, Feet, and Body
Usage: Home, Spa, and Wellness Care

How to Use
Apply a small amount of massage oil, serum, or moisturizer if desired
Hold the wooden handle comfortably
Gently massage the desired area using smooth circular or upward motions
Use the smaller end for the face, neck, and head
Use the larger surface for feet and other body areas
Clean the massage head after use and store in a dry place

Material / Composition
Kansa/Bronze Massage Head
Wooden Handle

Safety Information
For external use only
Use gentle pressure, especially on the face
Avoid use on broken, irritated, or injured skin
Discontinue use if discomfort or irritation occurs
Clean and dry after each use
Store in a cool and dry place
